listRecheck.notes: Re-read Oct 22, 2026. The page lists four measures, the same letters and jurisdictions as our records. Link texts read 'County of Napa - Measure B', 'City of American Canyon - Measure P', 'City of St Helena - Measure S', 'Town of Yountville - Measure Y'. The list itself gives no titles. Yountville is a town, not a city; our record says jurisdictionType city.

measures.officialTitleFound: The Napa County Wildfire Preparedness, Watershed Protection and Open Space Preservation Act of 2026
measures.titleNote: Our record has 'Title not recorded yet'. The county measure page shows the title above. The ballot title and summary document is headed 'AN INITIATIVE IMPOSING A ONE-HALF PERCENT (1/2%) SALES TAX FOR WILDFIRE PREPAREDNESS, WATERSHED PROTECTION, AND OPEN SPACE PRESERVATION'.

ballotQuestion.notes: The county measure page has no ballot question. The 'Ballot Title and Summary' PDF is the initiative's title and summary, and the reader reported it 'contains no question beginning with Shall'. The ballot label was not found in any official document read.

measureType.evidence: Measure B was placed on the ballot by citizen petition pursuant to the initiative process outlined ... in the California Elections Code.

threshold.evidence: Measure B, if approved by a simple majority (50% plus one vote) of the voters voting on November 3, 2026, will result in:
threshold.notes: Read twice; both readings returned the same sentence.

fiscal.text: Measure B would impose a countywide sales tax at the rate of one-half of one percent (1/2%). ... for eighteen (18) years, beginning on April 1, 2027, and ending on March 31, 2045
fiscal.notes: Ballot title and summary PDF agrees: 'The sales tax would be imposed for eighteen (18) years, beginning on April 1, 2027 and expiring on March 31, 2045.' No annual revenue estimate appears in the impartial analysis.

argumentsFiled.notes: The county page links an Argument in Favor (DocumentCenter/View/46100), Argument Against (46099), Rebuttal to Argument in Favor (46153) and Rebuttal to Argument Against (46152). The argument PDFs were not opened.

measures.plainEnglish: Adds a one-half percent (1/2%) sales tax throughout Napa County, including the cities, town and unincorporated areas, for 18 years from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2045. It was placed on the ballot by citizen petition.
measures.plainEnglishSupport: Impartial analysis sentences 'Measure B would impose a countywide sales tax at the rate of one-half of one percent (1/2%).' 'The tax would apply throughout Napa County, including the cities, town and the unincorporated areas of the county.' plus the duration and petition sentences quoted above.
